facts.en: Completed a furniture-making apprenticeship at Fictional Alderchisel Guild in 2011.
facts.zh: 2011 年在虚构桤凿行会完成家具制作学徒培训。

facts.en: Paid display maker at Fictional Ivoryhinge Exhibits from 2011-09 to 2017-12.
facts.zh: 2011-09 至 2017-12 在虚构象牙铰展陈公司任有薪展示装置制作员。

facts.en: Paid workshop supervisor at Fictional Lanternplinth Museum Services from 2018-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2018-01 至 2026-08 在虚构灯台博物馆服务公司任有薪工坊主管。

facts.en: Line-manages 5 fabricators, allocating approved jobs and conducting scheduled development conversations.
facts.zh: 直接管理 5 名制作员，分配获批工单，并定期开展员工发展沟通。

facts.en: Translates approved exhibit drawings into workshop cut lists, material reservations and assembly sequences.
facts.zh: 将获批展陈图纸转化为工坊下料清单、材料预留及装配顺序。

facts.en: Checks completed nonstructural display furniture against approved dimensions before arranging client inspection.
facts.zh: 安排客户检查前，依据获批尺寸核对已完成的非结构性展示家具。

facts.en: An external engineer approves load-bearing structures; the candidate does not sign engineering calculations.
facts.zh: 承重结构由外部工程师批准；候选人不签署工程计算。

facts.en: Requests material quotations and recommends purchases within the assigned workshop budget.
facts.zh: 在获分配工坊预算范围内索取材料报价并提出采购建议。

facts.en: The operations director signs supplier contracts and approves changes to the overall project budget.
facts.zh: 运营总监签署供应商合同，并批准整体项目预算变更。

facts.en: Led workshop delivery for a 2025-04 travelling display comprising 16 modular nonstructural plinths.
facts.zh: 2025-04 牵头完成巡展的工坊交付，包含 16 个模块化非结构性展台。

facts.en: Personally created the assembly sequence and supervised fit checks; a designer supplied the visual concept.
facts.zh: 个人制定装配顺序并监督适配检查；视觉概念由设计师提供。

facts.en: Workshop records show 15 plinths accepted at the first client inspection and 1 accepted after a surface-finish correction.
facts.zh: 工坊记录显示，15 个展台在首次客户检查时通过验收，1 个在修正表面饰面后通过验收。

facts.en: All 16 were accepted before the agreed dispatch date; the record gives no comparison with previous projects.
facts.zh: 全部 16 个展台均在约定发货日期前通过验收；记录未提供与既往项目的比较。

facts.en: Uses CAD drawings, workshop scheduling boards and spreadsheet materials forecasts.
facts.zh: 使用 CAD 图纸、工坊排程板及电子表格材料预测。

facts.en: Completed internal supervisor training on incident escalation and workshop induction in 2018-02.
facts.zh: 2018-02 完成有关事件升级上报及工坊入职培训的内部主管培训。

facts.en: Maintains training sign-off records and arranges supervised practice before assigning unfamiliar tasks.
facts.zh: 维护培训签署记录，并在分配不熟悉任务前安排受监督练习。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Coppersprig Repair Circle, helping repair small non-electrical household items.
facts.zh: 在虚构铜芽修理社做志愿者，协助修理小型非电器家居物品。

facts.en: Co-built a personal tabletop puppet theatre in 2022 with a sibling; personally made the folding frame.
facts.zh: 2022 年与一名兄弟姐妹共同制作个人桌面木偶剧场；个人制作折叠框架。

facts.en: Enjoys carving abstract wooden stamps during leisure time.
facts.zh: 爱好在闲暇时雕刻抽象木印章。

facts.en: Runs weekly workshop planning meetings and communicates capacity constraints to project managers.
facts.zh: 主持每周工坊计划会议，并向项目经理沟通产能限制。
